snippet.title: The Whistle | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Whistle is a FNaF Fangame based off the Josh Hutcherson Whistle Meme by MetroGirlzStation

About The Whistle:
You explore a seemingly operating "labrotori" to find Evidence using the labrotori's "FNAFENOES"
Right after you enter the building. The doors behind you suddenly Close. Having no choice. You Collect the FNAFENOES to get the Evidence just in case you survive and escape.

(What is a Fnafeno?:
The FNAFENOES are based off of a Knockoff FNaF game on the XBOX Store. after it got taken down. It later came back as "Mystic Epic Fnafena" which also got taken down.)

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/H8JmfR7cD5

Five Nights at Freddy's made by Scott Cawthon
